title: Where Do Multilingual Vision-Language Encoders Fail on Low-Resource Languages?
abstract: arXiv:2608.30725v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent multilingual vision--language encoders cover hundreds of languages in a single model, yet on two state-of-the-art instances retrieval on low-resource languages (LRL; e.g. Swahili) trails high-resource ones (HRL; e.g. English) by $30^+$\,pp. We ask where in the trained encoder this gap is located. Prior modality-gap and cross-lingual subspace work suggests a linear language direction at the output crowds out alignment-relevant geometry. We falsify this: LEACE drives the linear language classifier from $>99\%$ to near chance and iterated INLP to $37$--$50\%$ while LRL retrieval moves within $\pm 1.5$\,pp and all tier means within $2.2$\,pp, tracking random controls. The linear bias is a \emph{symptom}, not the cause. Instead, the alignment-causal factor lies along the encoder's forward path: the EOS (end-of-sequence) hidden state's per-language trajectory diverges with depth. translated_title: 多语言视觉-语言编码器在低资源语言上何处失效？
translated_abstract: 近期的多语言视觉-语言编码器在单一模型中覆盖了数百种语言，然而在两个最先进的模型实例上，低资源语言（LRL，如斯瓦希里语）的检索性能落后于高资源语言（HRL，如英语）30多个百分点。我们探究这一差距究竟位于训练好的编码器的哪个位置。先前的模态差距和跨语言子空间研究表明，输出端的线性语言方向可能会挤占与对齐相关的几何结构。我们证伪了这一假设：LEACE将线性语言分类器从超过99%降至接近随机水平，迭代INLP将其降至37-50%，而LRL检索性能仅在±1.5个百分点内变动，所有层级的均值变动在2.2个百分点以内，与随机对照组的表现一致。因此，线性偏差是症状而非原因。相反，造成对齐差异的因果因素位于编码器的前向路径中：EOS（序列结束）隐藏状态的各语言轨迹随深度增加而逐渐分化。用对应的英语EOS值替换EOS……
tldr: 该研究发现多语言视觉-语言编码器在低资源语言上检索性能落后的根源并非输出层的线性语言偏差，而是编码器前向传播过程中EOS隐藏状态的各语言轨迹随深度增加而逐渐分化。
en_tdlr: The study reveals that the retrieval gap on low-resource languages in multilingual vision-language encoders stems not from the linear language bias at the output, but from the divergence of per-language trajectories of the EOS hidden state along the encoder's forward path with increasing depth.
